stress.minimalTensor: t_ij=(D_i chi)^*D_j chi+(D_j chi)^*D_i chi-eta_ij[(D chi)^*D chi-M^2|chi|^2]
stress.energyVertex: v_00=0 on the pair shell, compatible with q_mu t^mu_nu=0 at q=(2E,0,0)

defectWardIdentity.distributionalForm: partial_mu Tbulk^{mu nu}+delta(y)[delta_i^nu partial_j tdef^{ji}-n^nu D]=external forces
defectWardIdentity.tangential: partial_i tdef^{ij} equals the jump of normal bulk momentum flux plus background-current forces
defectWardIdentity.normal: D is the displacement operator and equals the normal force mismatch after embedding variation
defectWardIdentity.topologicalSector: pure BF has zero Hilbert stress; edges, sources and charged matter contribute separately
defectWardIdentity.symmetricWall: the eta^2 reader well has zero first normal derivative at the wall center, but this does not close the full quantum displacement identity

schemeFreedom.improvement: one flat-space-visible scalar coefficient xi inherited from the curved defect coupling xi R_def |chi|^2
localContacts: local curvature-squared or source-derivative terms allowed by the effective cutoff
parity-odd gravitational contact terms if the symmetry permits them
schemeFreedom.contactEffect: real local contacts add momentum polynomials/distributions but no separated-frequency absorptive discontinuity
schemeFreedom.improvementEffect: improvement is not merely a contact; it changes trace-channel spectral matrix elements

schemeInvariantRemnant.observable: positive-frequency spectral measure of S=t_xx-t_yy at zero spatial momentum
schemeInvariantRemnant.reason: the scalar improvement shifts t_xx and t_yy equally, so it cancels in S; local contacts have no nonlocal spectral discontinuity
survives: anisotropic traceless absorption magnitude but not the orientation sign
shift from h=0 first S-visible threshold to h=1/2 first S-visible threshold
schemeInvariantRemnant.doesNotSurvive: the full 2x2 orientation-odd third matrix direction can be tuned to zero by an allowed improvement because it is the trace-traceless cross response

minimalMissingNormalization.parameter: xi_chi, equivalently one renormalization condition fixing the trace port relative to the traceless strain port
minimalMissingNormalization.operationalCondition: fix one reference matrix element of the trace stress, or fix the coefficient of R_def |chi|^2 in the curved defect action
minimalMissingNormalization.additionalEmbedding: a common calibrated map from the two laboratory ports to (trace, traceless strain) is still required for a physical H2 matrix
